full_judgment: Md Ruhul Amin J: This petition for leave to appeal is against the judgment and order dated August 20, 2001 of a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 1708 of 1997 making the Rule absolute obtained against the judgment and order dated January 19, 1997 of the 1st Court of Additional District Judge, Brahmanbaria, in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 8 of 1993 allowing the same upon reversing the judgment and order dated November 23, 1992 of the Court of Assistant Judge, Nasirnagar, Brahmanbaria, passed in Miscellaneous Case No. 9 of 1990 (under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950) allowing the prayer for pre-emption.
